data.narrative:
Valinor Enterprises is a Series A–stage defense and security company founded by Trae Stephens and Grant Verstandig, having raised $85M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparables (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $85M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $170M. Peer-median benchmarking across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—produces a median valuation of $400M, with the range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity within the peer set.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $144M to $460M, with a median of $285M. The stage-progression method suggests a lower bound anchored to capital deployed, while peer-median benchmarking indicates meaningfully higher valuations are supported by comparable transactions. Key uncertainties include the reliability of the peer set given its size disparity (particularly the $4.0B outlier in Stark Defence) and the extent to which Valinor's proprietary capabilities and market position justify positioning toward the upper or lower end of the range. Additional diligence on revenue trajectory and customer concentration would narrow this interval.
